images.author: Lucas County (Ohio). Auditor's Office
images.caption: This image was produced by the Auditor's Office in Lucas County, Ohio for tax assessment purposes. Associated dates are approximate. Descriptive terms related to this photograph include: false front |

facade.notes: Toledo assessor's card: a frame corner store with flats above; a flat roof with a thin projecting cornice; the storefront wraps the corner with display windows (posters inside); a separate door to the flats on the side street; a utility pole at the corner

why.note: the corner store: neighbourhood commerce takes the corner lot in a residential grid (two frontages, visible both ways), as Jacobs and space syntax predict
outside the fire limits a commercial building could still be frame
